companyStory.heading: Our Story
companyStory.paragraph1: Traveling Tokyo was founded with a deep passion for sharing the authentic beauty and rich culture of Japan with the world.
companyStory.paragraph2: Drawing from overseas experience and a background including studies at UCLA, our founder envisioned tours that offer genuine connections and unforgettable memories, highlighting the unique aspects of Japanese heritage.
